scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm wizard:check && pnpm data:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file ./seed/foundation.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file ./seed/catalog.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file ./seed/foundation.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file ./seed/catalog.sql
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown README.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml components.json eslint.config.js index.html tsconfig*.json vite.config.ts vitest*.config.ts wrangler.jsonc src worker test scripts .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown README.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml components.json eslint.config.js index.html tsconfig*.json vite.config.ts vitest*.config.ts wrangler.jsonc src worker test scripts .github
scripts.wizard:check: bash -n scripts/setup-infrastructure.sh test/cloudflare-resume.sh test/fixtures/wizard-command-stub.sh && scripts/setup-infrastructure.sh --check && bash test/cloudflare-resume.sh && node --test test/wrangler-config-updater.node.mjs && (! command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || shellcheck scripts/setup-infrastructure.sh test/cloudflare-resume.sh test/fixtures/wizard-command-stub.sh)
